headline: Global stock rout spreads to European and Asian markets
summary: Global stock markets experienced severe sell-offs, with sharp drops spreading across Asian bourses and hitting European markets following heavy losses in US equities.
why: Global equity indices frequently correlate during periods of broader international market risk aversion and macroeconomic stress.

impacts.name: Oslo Stock Exchange
impacts.why: Broader international market risk aversion triggered a severe sell-off across European and Asian equity exchanges.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Spillover from heavy losses in US equities triggered widespread selling across international stock exchanges.
